texts.facts: This is petition filed by the petitioner u/sec. 12 of Protection Of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005. 2. By filing this petition the petitioner has sought various reliefs fallen U/sec. 19, 20 and 22 of Pwdv Act- 2005. 3. Ever since the date of marriage, the petitioner has been residing at matrimonial home by discharging as dutiful wife to the first respondent. On the contrary, the first respondent and his sisters were not co-operating the petitioner to stay at matrimonial home and the sister-in- laws were not allowing the petitioner to lead happy married life with the first respondent. Thereafter, a Fir has been registered in Crime no.137/2018 for the offence punishable u/sec. 498-A of Ipc and u/sec. 3 & 4 of Dp Act against the first respondent and his family members and same is pending for adjudication. 9.
texts.arguments: The petitioner further submits that the first respondent has neglected the petitioner and the first respondent is also avoiding maintaining the petitioner for one or the other reasons. The first respondent being the husband of the petitioner, it is the bounden duty to maintain the petitioner by paying monthly Rs.25,000/- towards food, clothes, shelter and other expenses considering the status of the first respondent in the society and also it is necessary to meet the expenses of Rs.30,000/- towards litigation. When the petitioner tried to leave her marital house, the respondent was not living the petitioner to lead her own life.
